title: Huawei Honor Watch 4 link improvements
body:
Hi. I'm using MiaoMiao with xDrip+, and some days ago I received my new Huawei Honor Band 4. I'm very satisfied with it, for the wonderful screen visibility in daylight (finally!) and its many functions, but even more because it receives alerts from xDrip+ (as in attached image), vibrating once and showing them in the "Notifications" screen.
So here my query: given that they already speak each other, could it be possible to have on Huawei Honor Band 4 a new face with Blood Glucose value and trend arrow? And (or), could the vibration have more than one single impulse as actually, perhaps three?
This could avoid searching for the smartphone each time we wish to check the actual BG, e.g. by night.
Sorry for my bad English and thank you for your patience.
Andrea       :-)
![Huawei Honor band 4 shows xDrip+ alert](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/32884006/55672925-47420a00-58a1-11e9-83bd-f422b1b13d74.jpg)
